options.content:
**Estimates, not your AWS bill.** The figures come from public On-Demand list prices and current Spot prices, the EBS volumes attached to cluster instances, and the AWS PCS fees.

**Left out:** discounts, Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, credits, taxes, data transfer, public IPv4 addresses ($0.005 per address-hour), FSx and EFS, snapshots, load balancers, NAT gateways, CloudWatch, Marketplace software charges, Capacity Block and Dedicated Host instances, and PCS accounting storage.

Month and since-start totals leave out a resource for the time it was unpriced or its volumes couldn't be listed (such an instance counts as one volume). The Unpriced resource-hours stat shows how much.

**Per user:** a running job gets the largest of its CPU, GPU and memory shares of each node it runs on (memory only when Slurm schedules it), and the rest of a node's cost is unallocated, or idle when the node runs no job. [How the estimates are made](https://github.com/aws-samples/aws-parallelcluster-monitoring/blob/main/docs/cost-estimates.md)

targets.expr: (max(cluster_cost_collector_up{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"}) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}) or on() vector(-1)

((sum(cluster_cost_unpriced_resources{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"}) or on() vector(0)) and on() (max(cluster_cost_collector_stage_ok{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",stage="discovery"}) == 1)) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}

panels.title: Unpriced resource-hours this month
panels.description: Resource-hours that the month total leaves out because the resource had no price. Capacity Block and Dedicated Host instances are listed in the notice instead.

targets.expr: max by (stage, code) (cluster_cost_collector_stage_error{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"}) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}

panels.title: Projected this month
panels.description: Month-to-date cost plus the average cost per hour of the last 24 hours, for the hours left in the UTC month. When tracking started this month, the projection covers only the tracked part of the month.

targets.expr: ((sum(cluster_cost_idle_nodes{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"}) or on() vector(0)) and on() (max(cluster_cost_collector_stage_ok{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",stage="slurm"}) == 1)) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}

((sum(cluster_cost_unallocated_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",reason="idle_node"}) or on() vector(0)) and on() (max(cluster_cost_collector_stage_ok{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",stage="slurm"}) == 1)) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}

panels.title: Unallocated on busy nodes per hour

targets.expr: ((sum(cluster_cost_unallocated_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",reason="partial_node"}) or on() vector(0)) and on() (max(cluster_cost_collector_stage_ok{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",stage="slurm"}) == 1)) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}

panels.title: Idle cost by queue and type

targets.expr: sum by (queue, ec2_instance_type, purchase_option) (cluster_cost_unallocated_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",reason="idle_node"}) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}

((sum(cluster_cost_user_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"}) or on() vector(0)) and on() (max(cluster_cost_collector_stage_ok{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode",stage="slurm"}) == 1)) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}
topk(10, sum by (username) (cluster_cost_user_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"})) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}
topk(10, sum by (account) (cluster_cost_user_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"})) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}
topk(10, sum by (username) (cluster_cost_user_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"})) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}
sum by (username, account) (cluster_cost_user_usd_per_hour{job=~"ec2_instances|login_node",instance_name="HeadNode"}) and on() cluster_cost_collector:fresh{job=""}
